title: Finite orbit coproduct decomposition
statement: Let G : Type u be a compact topological group and M a discrete continuous G-action on a set in Type w. Write U for the forgetful functor to Type w. There exist I : Type w, a family A : I → DiscreteContAction (Type w) G, and equivariant inclusions f_i : A_i → M such that every underlying set A_i is finite, Cofan.mk M f is a colimit cocone, and U.mapCocone (Cofan.mk M f) is a colimit cocone in Type w. Both colimit assertions are expressed as Nonempty IsColimit and include the empty-action case.

proof.text: Use the quotient of the underlying action by the orbit equivalence relation as I, and the orbit subtypes as A_i. Equip them with the restricted action and discrete topology. Continuity follows from subtype continuity and equality of the subtype topology with the discrete topology. The inclusions are equivariant.
The stabilizer of an orbit representative is open by stabilizer_isOpen. The quotient is finite by quotient_finite_of_isOpen and the orbit-stabilizer equivalence makes the orbit finite.

Use selfEquivSigmaOrbits' to define the unique map out of the cocone, evaluating the chosen orbit map on each element. Its equivariance follows from equivariance of the component maps, and the same decomposition proves the factorization and uniqueness laws. The inverse sigma-orbit equivalence is bijective, so Cofan.nonempty_isColimit_iff_bijective_fromSigma proves the underlying set colimit. Transport it through isColimitMapCoconeEquiv. No element or representative is chosen for an empty orbit family.

lean.statement:
theorem discreteContAction_finite_orbit_coproduct
    (G : Type u) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] (M : DiscreteContAction (Type w) G) :
    let U := ObjectProperty.ι (ContAction.IsDiscrete (V := Type w) (G := G))
      ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (Action.IsContinuous (V := Type w) (G := G))
      ⋙ Action.forget (Type w) G
    ∃ (I : Type w) (A : I → DiscreteContAction (Type w) G) (f : ∀ i, A i ⟶ M),
      (∀ i, Finite (A i).obj.obj.V) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk M f)) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (U.mapCocone (Cofan.mk M f)))
